name: direction
title: Direction
description: Sets left-to-right or right-to-left reading for the Radix-based components inside it.
usage: Wrap a right-to-left page or region in DirectionProvider with dir="rtl" (and set dir on the element) so menus, sliders, tabs and toggle groups flip their keyboard and layout. useDirection reads the current direction.

reference.source: No dashboard counterpart: it sets the reading direction for the Radix controls in context-dashboard c0ddf7a src/components/ui/menu.tsx and src/components/ui/tabs.tsx
reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
